Definition: dell; the Maktesh, a place in Jerusalem
BiblicalUsage: Maktesh was the hollow, the merchant quarter of Jerusalem, named once, in Zephaniah 1:11, where the prophet cries, howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down and all they that bear silver are cut off. The merchant people are cut down in the same verse, and the silver they trusted in does not save them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the merchants of Maktesh are a warning to every market that trusts in silver: the silver stays, and the people are cut off.
